plan_review.notes: Revised plan: preview accepts a chosen candidate source path before promotion and freezes one server-side prepared request; final generation consumes that opaque token rather than rebuilding. The token captures effective brief, exact UTF-8 prompt, ordered seed/reference buffers and full SHA-256 digests, intended promoted target path, and source fingerprints. Generation fails closed if candidate bytes, manifest eligibility, pending dislike state, on-disk PNG bytes, or hashes drift; unreadable inputs are errors. Extension persists generating plus a unique generation nonce before the long inline call and applies/reconciles completion only for the same nonce and chosen source hash, recovering completed durable runs after a dropped request. Tests include seed-first order, exact provider parity, no queue enqueue, mutation/hash/dislike drift, stale completion, and local Sheet transition. Catalog returns lightweight metadata and lazy thumbnail URLs rather than all images inline.
